title: Normalized tensor and scalar-extension comparison data
statement: For a ring sheaf R on a site and module sheaves as in [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], define powers with degree zero R, degree one M, and successive powers associated to the left. The map on powers tensors a module morphism in every factor. A scalar-extension section is the image of s tensor x under the actual module sheafification unit [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. ScalarTensorCoherence records associators and both unitors specified on local pure tensors. ScalarExtensionTensorComparison records the normalized unit and binary scalar-extension comparisons, their associator and unitor squares, and natural recursively compatible power comparisons. InvertibleTensorScalarExtensionData additionally records internal-dual comparisons [def-pur-sheaf-hom], contravariant naturality and the normalized ring-tower maps with their power and dual squares. These are the existing data definitions of the parent node, relocated unchanged to allow its proof dependencies to refer to them without an import cycle.
